reports.limitations: Blend of CatBoost and Random Forest. Dataset fraud labels carry little signal (ROC-AUC ~0.55); accuracy and recall trade off. Default profile = highest validation recall with validation accuracy >= 87% (margin so test accuracy stays above 85%).
reports.evaluation_note: Fixed fitted estimator; exact precision-recall thresholds selected on validation only. 80% validation recall target. Test set was reported in prior release: repeated evaluation, not a fresh independent test.

quality.policy: Reject entire import on validation errors. No rows removed or labels changed.

decision_policy: Default: Hybrid CatBoost+Random Forest at the threshold giving highest validation recall with accuracy >= 87% (margin so test accuracy stays above 85%). Profiles balanced / high_recall / accuracy_85 selectable.
